title: Performance: Command Execution Timeout Threshold Optimization
problem: PowerShell command execution timeout threshold too low (5s) causes tool failures on slow WMI/Registry queries
evidence: systemInfo, wmiPersistence, network tools timeout at 5s threshold
Actual execution time: 6-8s for complex queries
Increasing timeout to 15s resolves all timeout failures
cause: Global timeout configuration in shared.js set too aggressively. WMI cold-start queries require 6-8s minimum.

recommended_actions.action: Increase PowerShell execution timeout from 5s to 15s in shared.js

notes: High-confidence discovery: 93% confidence. Fixes 5+ tool timeouts with single global timeout increase.
